title: My Ordinary Life
lyrics:
[00:04.61]Jā, iku zo
[00:06.05]Jan, ken, pon
[00:30.12]They tell me keep it simple, I tell them take it slow
[00:32.86]I feed and water an idea so I let it grow
[00:35.58]I tell them take it easy, they laugh and tell me no
[00:38.31]It's cool, but I don't see them laughing at my money, though
[00:41.03]They spitting facts at me, I'm spitting tracks, catch me?
[00:43.74]I'm spinning gold out my records, know you can't combat me
[00:46.49]They tell me Jesus walks, I tell them money talks
[00:49.09]Bling got me chill 'cause I'm living in an ice box
[00:51.93]They tell me I've been sleeping, I say I'm wide awake
[00:54.46]Tracks hot and ready so they call me Mister E-Z Bake
[00:57.40]They say the grass is greener, I think my grass is dank
[00:59.93]Driving with a drank on an empty tank to the bank
[01:03.01]Do you feel me? Take a look inside my brain
[01:05.23]The people always different, but it always feel the same
[01:08.44]That's the real me, pop the champagne
[01:10.69]The haters wanna hurt me and I'm laughing at the pain
[01:13.95]Staying still, eyes closed
[01:16.40]Let the world just pass me by
[01:19.52]Pain pills, nice clothes
[01:21.90]If I fall, I think I'll fly
[01:24.92]Touch me, Midas
[01:27.38]Make me part of your design
[01:30.42]None to guide us
[01:32.68]I feel fear for the very last time
[01:57.38]They tell me that I'm special, I smile and shake my head
[02:00.10]I'll give them stories to tell friends about the things I said
[02:02.81]They tell me I'm so humble, I say I'm turning red
[02:05.55]They let me lie to them and don't feel like they've been misled
[02:08.30]They give so much to me, I'm losing touch, get me?
[02:10.96]Served on a silver platter, ask for seconds, they just let me
[02:13.76]They tell me I'm a god, I'm lost in the façade
[02:16.26]Six feet off the ground at all times, I think I'm feeling odd
[02:19.19]No matter what I make, they never see mistakes
[02:21.73]Making so much bread, I don't care that they're just being fake
[02:24.62]They tell me they're below me, I act like I'm above
[02:27.13]The people blend together, but I would be lost without their love
[02:30.25]Can you heal me? Have I gained too much?
[02:32.48]When you become untouchable, you're unable to touch
[02:35.56]Is there a real me? Pop the champagne
[02:37.91]It hurts me just to think, and I don't do pain
[02:41.16]Staying still, eyes closed
[02:43.70]Let the world just pass me by
[02:46.81]Pain pills, nice clothes
[02:49.17]If I fall, I think I'll fly
[02:52.19]Touch me, Midas
[02:54.66]Make me part of your design
[02:57.68]None to guide us
[02:59.92]I feel fear for the very last time
[03:03.15]Lay still, restless
[03:05.56]Losing sleep while I lose my mind
[03:08.65]All thrill, no stress
[03:10.98]All my muses left behind
[03:14.08]World is below
[03:16.39]So high up, I'm near divine
[03:19.50]Lean in, let go
[03:21.72]I feel fear for the very last time
